(img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || '') : ''; const title = clean(decode(link.textContent || (img ? (img.getAttribute('alt') || img.getAttribute('title')) : '') || id)); if (!title || !cover || /gravatar/i.test(cover)) return; seen[id] = true; out.push({ id, title, cover: coverUrl(cover), url: abs(href), status: 'completed' }); }); return JSON.stringify(out); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.1y.is'; const text = document.body ? document.body.textContent : ''; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const coverUrl = (v) => { const u = String(v || ''); if (!u) return ''; if (/\.webp(\?|#|$)/i.test(u)) return 'https://wsrv.nl/?url=' + u + '&w=480&output=jpg'; return u; }; const normalizeId = (href) => { try { const u = new URL(href, base); return (u.pathname + u.search).replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) { return String(href || '').replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } }; const out = []; try { const arr = JSON.parse(text); if (Array.isArray(arr)) arr.forEach((item) => { const url = item.link || item.url || ''; const title = clean((item.title && item.title.rendered) || item.title || normalizeId(url)); const media = item._embedded && item._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'] && item._embedded['wp:featuredmedia'][0]; let cover = media ? (media.source_url || (media.media_details && media.media_details.sizes && media.media_details.sizes.medium && media.media_details.sizes.medium.source_url) || '') : ''; if (!cover && item.content && item.content.rendered) { const m = String(item.content.rendered).match(/<img[^>]+src=["']([^"']+)/i); cover = m ? m[1] : ''; } const id = normalizeId(url); if (id && title) out.push({ id, title, cover: coverUrl(cover), url, status: 'completed' }); }); } catch (e) {} return JSON.stringify(out); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.1y.is'; const clean = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const coverUrl = (v) => { const u = abs(v); if (!u) return ''; if (/\.webp(\?|#|$)/i.test(u)) return 'https://wsrv.nl/?url=' + u + '&w=480&output=jpg'; return u; }; const title = clean((document.querySelector('h1.entry-title') && document.querySelector('h1.entry-title').textContent) || document.title); const img = document.querySelector('.entry-content img.alignnone, .entry-content img[src*="1y.is"], .post-thumbnail img'); const cover = img ? coverUrl(img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || '') : ''; const desc = clean((document.querySelector('.entry-content blockquote') && document.querySelector('.entry-content blockquote').textContent) || (document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]') && document.querySelector('meta[name="description"]').getAttribute('content')) || ''); const author = clean((document.querySelector('.author a') && document.querySelector('.author a').textContent) || '1Y Beauties'); return JSON.stringify({ title, cover, author, status: 'completed', description: desc }); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.1y.is'; let raw = String('{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw; return new URL(raw.replace(/^\/+/, ''), base.replace(/\/+$/, '/') ).href; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.1y.is'; const title = ((document.querySelector('h1.entry-title') && document.querySelector('h1.entry-title').textContent) || 'Gallery').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim(); const canonical = (document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]') && document.querySelector('link[rel="canonical"]').getAttribute('href')) || location.href; const stripPage = (v) => String(v || '').replace(/\/\d+\/?$/, ''); const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const chapterUrl = stripPage(abs(canonical)); const entries = [{ num: 1, url: chapterUrl }]; document.querySelectorAll('.entry-content .page-links a.post-page-numbers[href], .page-links a.post-page-numbers[href]').forEach((a) => { const n = parseInt((a.textContent || '').replace(/\D+/g, ''), 10); const href = abs(a.getAttribute('href') || ''); if (n > 1 && /\.html\/\d+\/?$/i.test(href)) entries.push({ num: n, url: href }); }); const seen = {}; const chapters = []; entries.sort((a, b) => a.num - b.num).forEach((entry) => { if (seen[entry.url]) return; seen[entry.url] = true; let id = entry.url; try { const u = new URL(entry.url); id = (u.pathname + u.search).replace(/^\/+|\/+$/g, ''); } catch (e) {} chapters.push({ id, title: entries.length > 1 ? ('Page ' + entry.num) : 'Gallery', url: entry.url, date: '', publishTime: '' }); }); return JSON.stringify(chapters.length ? chapters : [{ id: chapterUrl, title, url: chapterUrl, date: '', publishTime: '' }]); })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.1y.is'; let raw = String('{{chapterId}}' || '{{mangaId}}' || '').trim(); if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(raw)) return raw; return new URL(raw.replace(/^\/+/, ''), base.replace(/\/+$/, '/') ).href; })();

(() => { const base = 'https://www.1y.is'; const pages = []; const seen = {}; const abs = (v) => { try { return new URL(v, location.href || base).href; } catch (e) { return String(v || ''); } }; const push = (v) => { const url = abs(v); if (!/\.(jpg|jpeg|png|webp)(\?|#|$)/i.test(url)) return; if (/gravatar|avatar|banner|jads|favicon/i.test(url)) return; if (seen[url]) return; seen[url] = true; pages.push({ index: pages.length, page: pages.length, url, imageUrl: url }); }; document.querySelectorAll('.entry-content img.alignnone, .entry-content p img, .entry-content img[src*="/wp-content/uploads/"], .entry-content img[src*="imgs.1y.is"]').forEach((img) => push(img.getAttribute('data-src') || img.getAttribute('data-original') || img.getAttribute('src') || '')); return JSON.stringify(pages); })();

changes: Proxy list, search and detail covers through wsrv.nl as JPEG.
Keep reader page image URLs unchanged.

Rebuilt workflows from current site HTML.
